description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the HTML configuration of the Daux documentation generator. It tests the creation and retrieval of the 'edit_on' configuration and verifies different formats and sources for this setting.

classes.name: ConfigTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing HTML configuration in Daux.

methods.name: testHTMLConfigCreation
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new HTML configuration object and verifies its 'edit_on' property.

methods.name: providerEditOn
methods.description: Provides test data for different 'edit_on' configurations and expected results.

methods.name: testEditOn
methods.description: Tests the handling of various 'edit_on' configuration inputs and checks the output.
